question: Emmys 2026: Outstanding variety series
resolution_criteria:
The 78th Primetime Emmy Awards, given by the Academy of Television Arts & Sciences, honor the best in American prime time television programming aired between June 1, 2025, until May 31, 2026. The awards ceremony is scheduled for September 14, 2026, at the Peacock Theater in Downtown Los Angeles, California

This market will resolve according to the nominee who wins the 2026 Emmy award for “Outstanding variety series”.

If for any reason no winner is declared by October 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or in case of overall cancellation or a tie for winner, this market will resolve in favor of the nominee which comes first in alphabetical order.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the Academy of Television Arts & Sciences and the Emmys, including data from their websites (e.g. https://theemmys.tv/, https://www.televisionacademy.com/) and the live broadcast of the award ceremony, however a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
research:
I couldn't find any reported winner dated on or before 2026-09-05. *The Late Show With Stephen Colbert* was the clear prediction-market favorite as of September 2-4, at roughly 72-76%.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-07-08: The Television Academy announced the nominees for the newly merged Outstanding Variety Series category. They are *The Daily Show* (Comedy Central), *Jimmy Kimmel Live!* (ABC), *Last Week Tonight With John Oliver* (HBO), *The Late Show With Stephen Colbert* (CBS) and *Saturday Night Live* (NBC). [LateNighter](https://latenighter.com/news/emmys-variety-series-nominees-2026/), [TV Insider](https://www.tvinsider.com/1274192/2026-emmys-nominees-full-list/)
- How voting works:
  - The category merges the old Talk Series and Scripted Variety Series races.
  - Voters give each nominee a yes or a no rather than picking one show.
  - Any show with yes votes from at least 90% of voters wins, so there can be more than one winner.
  - If no show reaches 90%, the show with the highest share of yes votes wins.
  - This matters for the market: if there's a tie, it resolves to the nominee that comes first alphabetically. [LateNighter](https://latenighter.com/news/emmys-variety-series-nominees-2026/)
- Final-round voting ran from August 17 to August 26, 2026 (10 p.m. PT). The winner will be announced at the September 14 ceremony on NBC and Peacock. [LateNighter](https://latenighter.com/news/emmys-variety-series-nominees-2026/)

## 2. Current status
- Voting has closed. As of 2026-09-05 I found no announced winner, so nothing settles the question yet.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-04: Market reporting says *The Late Show* was at 72% on Kalshi and 74% on Polymarket. [Prediction Hunt](https://www.predictionhunt.com/news/colbert-told-emmy-voters-to-pick-kimmel-sep-04-2026)
- 2026-09-02: *The Late Show* fell about 10 points over three days to 72% on Kalshi and 76% on Polymarket, and the report found no public trigger. [Prediction Hunt](https://www.predictionhunt.com/news/late-show-emmy-odds-fall-10-points-sep-02-2026)
- Around 2026-08-25, during voting: Colbert posted a video urging Academy members to vote for *Jimmy Kimmel Live!*. According to the report, *The Late Show* dropped from about 87% to about 73%, with a low of 64%. [TV Insider](https://www.tvinsider.com/1283705/stephen-colbert-campaigns-for-jimmy-kimmel-to-win-emmy-in-surprise-video/), [Variety AU](https://au.variety.com/?p=39744)
- August 2026: Colbert received the TCA Career Achievement Award, and *The Late Show* won the TCA award for Outstanding Achievement in Variety, Talk or Sketch. [Prediction Hunt](https://www.predictionhunt.com/news/late-show-emmy-odds-fall-10-points-sep-02-2026)
- Before 2026-09-05: Colbert's writers ran their own Emmy campaign after CBS decided not to run one. [LateNighter](https://latenighter.com/?p=83166)
- 2026-07-08: *The Late Show*'s final season got 9 nominations, its biggest haul ever. The series finale aired May 21 to 9.1 million viewers. [Variety AU](https://au.variety.com/2026/tv/news/stephen-colbert-emmys-nominations-final-season-38390/), [Prediction Hunt](https://www.predictionhunt.com/news/late-show-emmy-odds-fall-10-points-sep-02-2026)

## 4. Base rates
- This is the first year in more than a decade that talk shows and sketch shows compete in one category. [LateNighter](https://latenighter.com/news/emmys-variety-series-nominees-2026/)
- From memory, not re-checked:
  - Under the old combined format, *The Daily Show* won 2003-2012 and 2015, and *The Colbert Report* won 2013-2014.
  - *Last Week Tonight* won Variety Talk 2016-2022 and has dominated Scripted Variety since.
  - *The Late Show* won Talk Series in 2025, after the cancellation was announced.
- 2025-08-13, previous cycle: Gold Derby odds in the talk category moved *The Late Show* from 26% to 65% after the cancellation news. At that point it had 9 straight losses in the category, and *The Daily Show* was the two-time defending champion. [LateNighter](https://latenighter.com/news/colberts-late-show-surges-to-emmy-favorite-after-cancellation-shock/)
- *SNL* is the most Emmy-decorated series in history. However, I found no evidence that it has won a top series award against talk shows in recent years.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-09-02/04: Kalshi had *The Late Show* at 72%, and Polymarket had it at 74-76%. [Prediction Hunt](https://www.predictionhunt.com/news/colbert-told-emmy-voters-to-pick-kimmel-sep-04-2026)
- I couldn't find pre-cutoff prices for the other nominees. From pre-cutoff reporting, *Jimmy Kimmel Live!* looks like the main alternative.
- 2026-07-12: A thin PredScope snapshot (about $15K volume) briefly had *Jimmy Kimmel Live!* in the lead at 30%. That was well before later price moves, so it's outdated. [PredScope](https://predscope.com/event/emmys-2026-outstanding-variety-series)
- Kalshi offered a "multiple winners" outcome, so traders were pricing in a tie under the 90% rule. Under this question's rules, a tie resolves alphabetically. The market listing for this question isn't clear about how quotation marks or "The" affect that ordering.
- Gold Derby has predictions pages for this race, but the snippets I found were unclear individual user picks, not a consensus. [Gold Derby](https://www.goldderby.com/members/stephenzumpano/)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- The Creative Arts Emmys, held the weekend after September 5, should show how strong *The Late Show* is in the craft categories. Results there could move prices.
- 2026-09-14: The main ceremony, where the winner is announced. Votes are already cast, so any news from here on only changes the odds, not the outcome.
